names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Μαΐου, «Αγίες Ολυμπία και Ευφροσύνη οι Οσιομάρτυρες», with the rank word left off; the page's own head line for her is «Αγια Ευφροσυνη η Οσιομαρτυρας (; - 1235)».

death.note: saint.gr: «Η Οσία Ολυμπία και η οσία Ευφροσύνη έζησαν τον 13ο αιώνα μ.Χ. και παρέδωσαν την ψυχή τους με μαρτυρικό θάνατο στις 11 Μαΐου του 1235 μ.Χ.», and the head line over her name gives «(; - 1235)». The page gives no year for her birth and calls her only a γερόντισσα, an old nun.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, **and gives each of the two her own head line**, so the pair is two folders; her companion is the corpus's `olympia-of-lesvos`, which gets a Greek row of its own from this same page. **She is none of the corpus's other Euphrosynes** — of Alexandria, of Mega Spileo — and the name sweep's strong rows for this line were all raised off Olympia's name, not hers. **The thirty nuns of the house are not named** — «διασκόρπισαν τις τριάντα μοναχές και όσες δεν πρόλαβαν να φύγουν, τις κακοποίησαν» — so they are no folders. **`locations` are left out** although Thermi and Mytilene on Lesvos are named: the monastery of Karyai, now the monastery of Saint Raphael, is where she died, and the page locates her nowhere else. **The relics named on the page are Olympia's, not hers**: part at the monastery of Saint Raphael at Thermi and a fragment at Mega Spilaio of Kalavryta. **The two apolytikia on the page name Olympia only** and are taken there, not here: they are not this saint's hymns, and no hymn is stored for her.
